move: brand shapes bounce in from corners, words push up, dot pops, confetti
how: Four 220px shapes in Figma brand colours (circle, half-circles, arch) bounce in from the four corners (x/y +/-400/300, +/-90deg rotation, back.out(1.5) 1s, 100ms apart) on a dark grey stage. A kicker, three big word lines (Ready / for / Config) and a date line rise out of overflow masks (yPercent 115-120 to 0, expo.out 0.7-0.9s, 120ms stagger) from 9% to 17%. At 24% a green centre dot pops in with back.out(3) and shrinks away at 32% as sixty confetti bits fire outward in seeded directions (260-640px, rotation 360-900deg, power3.out 1.4-2s) with gravity offset and fade. The shapes then slowly rotate +/-90deg (sine.inOut 4.6s) and hop 30px four times in staggered sync. From 86% the words push up out of their masks and the shapes fly back out to their corners with back.in(1.5).
adapt: Replace the kicker, three word lines, date and the shape colours/radii; confetti count and palette are arrays. Keep the 1s back.out(1.5) corner entries, the 120ms word stagger and the confetti burst at 31%.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the shapes, confetti bits (seeded rng) and copy lines inside el. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with labels at fractions of D and exits at D-1.3 onward; the 400/300px throws should scale with el size.
caveats: sixty confetti elements each with their own fromTo tween
from() tweens need immediateRender:false when built late
